next.reason: 2023 adds FROM literal-1 (§2023:14.9.35.4 GR7: "MOVE literal-1 TO record-name-1"), which the 1985 format refuses; the FROM identifier-1 case is unchanged. §2023:14.9.35.4 GR7 keeps the equivalence: MOVE identifier-1 TO record-name-1 per the MOVE rules, then 'The same REWRITE statement without the FROM phrase'; §2023:14.9.35.3 SR6 states the MOVE-validity part ('shall be valid as a sending operand in a MOVE statement'). Literal-1 is new syntax only.
